typographyMood.primary: Avenir Next / SF Pro Display fallback
typographyMood.tone: editorial headers with calm technical body copy

geometryLanguage.shapeBias: long horizontal shells, compressed status pills, framed panes

materialsAndLighting.lightingRig: soft top wash, edge glows for live state, restrained bloom only in hero visualizations
materialsAndLighting.shadowModel: short directional shadows with dark ambient grounding

reactiveRules: Reactive visuals must trail truth, not replace it
All live overlays need smoothing and deadband
Diagnostics animate slower than scene objects

directions.name: Conservative
directions.summary: Keep the current dark studio-console language and mainly compress hierarchy, header truth, and diagnostic exposure.

directions.name: On-brand
directions.summary: Spatial Atelier: a viewport-led shell with a gold authority spine, cyan live-state accents, and a clean Focus-versus-Lab split.

directions.name: Experimental
directions.summary: Push time-layered 4D histories, denser reactive fields, and more sculptural materials, but keep them behind lab affordances.

finalRecommendation.rationale: It sharpens scope and trust without forcing a full visual reinvention or adding cross-runtime fragility.
